description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム F91プリクエル』より、新世代小型ＭＳ“Ｆ９１”１号機、２号機の２体セットがＨＧシリーズにて商品化。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam F91 Prequel ", a set of two new generation small MS " F91" Units 1 and 2 will be commercialized in the HG series.

description.ja: ２機のカラーリングをそれぞれ成形色で再現。新規武装“ビーム・マシンガン”が付属。
description.en: The coloring of the two aircraft is reproduced with each molding color. A new weapon "beam machine gun" is included.

description.en: The beam machine gun that Units 1 and 2 are equipped with is included as a new model.

description.ja: サイドグリップは可動ギミックを搭載。

description.ja: ●　特徴的な機体カラーを成形色で再現。

description.ja: 印象的な白を基調とした機体カラーをはじめ、１号機、２号機で配色の異なるカラーリングを成形色で再現。
description.en: Including the impressive white-based aircraft color, the different color schemes of Units 1 and 2 are reproduced in molding colors.

description.ja: ●　識別マーキング等を収録した新規デザインのマーキングシールが付属。
description.en: ● Comes with a newly designed MarkingSeal that includes identification markings, etc.
